payload.reason: The evidence describes the use of a question generation model in the context of knowledge-based machine reading comprehension, where it generates questions based on candidate answers and integrates external knowledge bases.

claims.text: A question generation model is used in knowledge-based machine reading comprehension to generate questions based on the semantics of candidate answers.
The question generation model is part of a framework that includes both question answering and question generation components, leveraging external knowledge bases.
The model employs a sequence to sequence architecture to effectively generate questions from input facts and candidate answers.
